author: Keldas
text_post: self help/inner game books and DVDs I'm glad my post on alphaness has elicited so many responses. If these debates help someone shift their perspective that's great. OK, onto personal bugbear number two. Self help books and inner game CDs/DVDs. I'm sorry, but I think they are a complete waste of time.  Has there ever been an industry that promised so much and delivered so little? The self-help industry must generate millions of dollars a year. But I doubt there are many people who have benefited in the long term from reading one of these books and listening to one of these CDs. I can only speak for myself. I purchased one of DYDs products a while ago. I got all excited about it for a week or so. Then I put it away and its collecting dust in some cupboard. I don't think it had any long term effect on the way that I percieve myself and the world around me. Let's take a look at another one of these products. Mr Tolle's book 'The power of now'. Everyone seems to be talking about it. Its very chic to be seen carrying a copy, don't you know? Does anyone seriously believe that reading a book is going to teach you how to stay in the present moment?  If you want to train yourself to be in the present moment try some yoga or meditation. People have been benefiting from these practices for thousands of years. Or let's take some of these inner game products. Do you really believe that listening to Tyler Durden waffling on for 20 hours is really going to change your life? C'mon be serious. You get good at pickup by making approaches. Trial and error... And if you really want to get good save your money and get some expert advice. Go on a bootcamp or do a one to one.  If you don't think you have solid enough inner game to pull some chick, take a look at some of the sorry specimens out there who are getting laid. These guys don't have better inner game than you. Many of these people are riddled with insecurities. They're just more motivated to seek out sex that you. If someone thinks these products work, please post and explain your reasons for thinking so. I am always open to being persuaded otherwise. I like to think I have an open mind.

author: Dagon
text_post: I couldn't agree more with your post! So true! If you really want to be good at this, you should seek practical, realistic advice, not weird new agy mambo-jumbo. You should learn to correct your body language, how to move, how to walk, how to hold eye contact, how to relax... You should better your tonality, your expressiveness, your speech pacing... You should learn how to qualify a girl, how to attract them, which the attraction switches are, etc. You should not waste your time trying to make yourself believe that you are the ultimate catch hoping that it will 'magically' project outwards and make every chick you encounter attracted. You should not waste your time developing 'rock-solid' confidence with no foundations at all. I really like some of the definitions Mystery himself has given in the past: 1) When we say that it doesn't matter what you say but how you say it, we mean that you can use many different things and make them to have the desired effect on the girl, but these things need to be NORMAL. If you don't believe me, try approaching a girl with the line 'hello motherfucking bitch!'. No matter how you say it, you will get a nasty reaction. Remember what happened when Cajun used a bad opener in the 'Keys to the VIP'? The reaction was not good despite his powerful subcommunication. Of course he saved it later because he is so good, but the initial reaction wasn't positive. 2) Competence is the real deal, not confidence. And he explains it very well. Being confident that you can drive a car doesn't allow you to do so. However, knowing how to drive a car does. Note: I don't say that having good inner game is useless. In fact it is a great achievement being in harmony with yourself. But that alone will not get you laid.
